source:
@@U03933@@
Never let loose of this dress!
Never!
Demons already are plucking away at its edges,
eager to drag it off to the underworld.
Hold fast to it, I say!
This may no longer be the goddess you've lost,
but it is divine.
Make the most of this favor beyond all price
and raise yourself up with it.
It will bear you swiftly above all things common
into vast Spaces as long as you survive.
We'll meet again, we two,
far, very far from here.
(海伦’: clothes dissolve into clouds, surround 浮士德, bear him aloft,
and move off with him. 福耳库阿斯 picks up 欧福里翁 5 robe,
cloak, and lyre and advances into the proscenium, holds them up, and
speaks.)

@@U03935@@
No mean find, these, no matter what.
The flame may have disappeared,
but it won't be the death of poetry,
you'll see. With these
I can always get things started, don't you know,
get the poetic juices flowing,
stir up a little jealousy among professionals.
And though I may not have talent to lend,
at least I have the costume to be lent.

@@U03936@@
(She sits down in the proscenium at the foot of a column.)

@@U03938@@
Move along there, girls!
Quick, now!
We're rid at last of that witch’s befuddling
Thessalian magic! No more jingle-jangle
of her tinkling tunes that so confuse the ears
translation:
@@U03933@@
永远不要松开这件衣服！
绝不！
恶魔已经在拔掉它的边缘，
急于将其拖入地下世界。
我说，坚持住！
这或许不再是你失去的女神，
但这是神圣的。
充分利用这一优惠，超越一切代价
并以此提升自己。
它会比一切平凡的事物更快地承载你
只要你还活着，就可以进入广阔的空间。
我们两个还会再见面的
离这里很远很远。
海伦：衣裳化云，围浮士德，高举浮士德。
并和他一起离开。 福耳库阿斯拿起欧福里翁5袍，
披风和竖琴，走进台口，把它们举起来，然后
说话。）

@@U03935@@
无论如何，找到这些都不是一件容易的事。
火焰可能已经消失了
但这不会是诗歌的消亡，
你会看到的。有了这些
我总能把事情开始，你知道吗？
让诗意的汁液流动，
激起专业人士的一点嫉妒。
虽然我可能没有才华可以借出，
至少我还有可以借的服装。

@@U03936@@
（她坐在柱子脚下的台口上。）

@@U03938@@
往那里走吧，女孩们！
快点，现在！
我们终于摆脱了那个女巫的迷惑
色萨利魔法！不再有叮叮当当
她那叮当作响的曲调让耳朵感到困惑
